top_signals.title: htmx 4.0.0 has been released!
top_signals.summary: In addition, the following changes were made: Most error events collapse into htmx:error. HTTP error responses fire htmx:response:error. The htmx:xhr:* events are removed. htmx 4 uses fetch(). The htmx:validation:* events are removed in favor of native browse…
